rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken adjective for a gay person and can also modify nouns for gay-oriented things.

example.english: My older male cousin is gay and is still dating his boyfriend.
example.traditional: 我個表哥係基，仲同男朋友拍緊拖。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 biu2 go1 hai6 gei1 zung6 tung4 naam4 pang4 jau5 paak3 gan2 to1

rows.note: Use this for something considered lame, useless, uncool, or generally bad.

example.english: That movie was really gay; it made me want to fall asleep.
example.traditional: 呢套戲真係廢，睇到我想瞓覺。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 fai3 tai2 dou2 ngo5 soeng2 fan3 gaau3

rows.note: Use this when A is someone of the same sex and the context makes the romantic or sexual interest clear.

example.english: Ming seems gay; he is interested in his male coworker.
example.traditional: 阿明對個男同事有意思，睇嚟佢係基。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 deoi3 go3 naam4 tung4 si6 jau5 ji3 si1 tai2 lai4 keoi5 hai6 gei1
